links.outcome: Expert-rated quality (DISCERN) of ChatGPT-4 answers on penile prosthesis consent questions
links.effect: Mean DISCERN 2.57-2.79 across categories (moderate); risks and alternative treatments scored lowest (<2); inter-rater ICC 0.76.
links.quote: ChatGPT currently provides variable and often inadequate quality information without sufficient comprehensibility for informed patient decisions, indicating the need for further improvements in quality and readability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-4's performance (quality and readability) on simulated patient questions regarding informed consent for penile prosthesis implantation without testing specific deployment practices or interventions.
